Turquía e Israel también intercambiaron críticas esta semana en relación con Siria, donde Israel llevó a cabo ataques aéreos contra una base aérea en la que, según dijo, podrían desplegarse soldados turcos, lo que provocó la condena de Ankara y las críticas de Estados Unidos. Siria ha dicho que no había planes de desplegar soldados turcos en la base. La influencia de Turquía en Siria, como aliada del presidente sirio Ahmed al-Sharaa, ha despertado la alarma israelí desde que Sharaa derrocó al veterano líder Bashar al-Asad en 2024. Ankara ha afirmado que la retórica israelí contra Turquía y sus acciones en Siria se ven avivadas por la proximidad de las elecciones parlamentarias que se celebrarán en Israel en octubre.

item.title: Raiders not quite ready to name starting quarterback
item.description: Las Vegas Raiders coach Klint Kubiak is in no rush to name a starting quarterback and says the battle between rookie Fernando Mendoza and veteran Kirk Cousins will continue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las Vegas Raiders coach Klint Kubiak is in no rush to name a starting quarterback and says the battle between rookie Fernando Mendoza and veteran Kirk Cousins will continue. "We got another week. I don't want anyone to be comfortable in their job," Kubiak said after Thursday's preseason road win against the Houston Texans. "It should always be that way for all positions. So, let's keep going." Mendoza, the Heisman Trophy winner and No. 1 overall draft pick, started the 22-20 victory and threw an 80-yard pick-six in the first quarter. He played the first half and completed 8 of 15 passes for 86 yards. "Coach Kubiak outlined for the team what the plan was going to be with the starters, essentially for Weeks 1, 2 and 3 of the preseason, [and] to keep it internally," Mendoza said. "That was something I knew going into the game was going to be a great experience as a first start in the NFL preseason, which is always the next step." Cousins, who turned 38 on Wednesday, did not take any snaps against the Texans after playing just one drive in the preseason opener vs. Arizona on Aug. 13. Cousins was 5-of-6 passing for 50 yards and a touchdown against the Cardinals, while the 22-year-old Mendoza threw for 97 yards and a TD on 10-of-16 passing. Las Vegas concludes preseason action at home against the San Francisco 49ers next Thursday and opens the regular season against the visiting Miami Dolphins on Sept. 13. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mexican governor accused by US of cartel ties returns to office
item.description: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following U.S. drug trafficking charges alleging ties to the Sinaloa Cartel, a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following U.S. drug trafficking charges alleging ties to the Sinaloa Cartel, a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States. Rocha, 77, a member of Mexico's ruling Morena party, said he was resuming his duties after Mexican authorities found no evidence to support the accusations against him. In a statement posted on X, Rocha denied wrongdoing and cast the U.S. case as a politically motivated attack on Mexico's sovereignty and on the leftist movement led by President Claudia Sheinbaum. The U.S. State Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Mexico has so far declined to act on U.S. efforts to bring Rocha into custody, saying Washington has not provided sufficient evidence to justify domestic arrest warrants or extradition. For U.S. officials, the April indictment marked a rare expansion of anti-cartel action beyond drug bosses to include a sitting senior Mexican politician. U.S. prosecutors alleged Rocha and nine other current and former officials conspired with a faction of the Sinaloa Cartel known as Los Chapitos, helping it traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for political support and bribes. Rocha has repeatedly denied the allegations. He stepped aside temporarily in early May as Mexican authorities reviewed the case, and said on Friday he was returning with his "head held high."

item.title: Tesla e outras empresas iniciam recall recorde de veículos na China
item.description: A Tesla e outras oito montadoras anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que farão um recall de um total de cerca de 4,3 milhões de veículos na China devido a preocupações de que as portas possam ser difíceis de abrir em caso de emergência, o que representa o maior recall automotivo do país.
item.dc:creator: Qiaoyi Li, Ju-min Park
item.content:encoded: A Tesla e outras oito montadoras anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que farão um recall de um total de cerca de 4,3 milhões de veículos na China devido a preocupações de que as portas possam ser difíceis de abrir em caso de emergência, o que representa o maior recall automotivo do país. As medidas corretivas do recall vão desde atualizações de software até etiquetas de aviso e marcações aprimoradas ao redor das maçanetas das portas. Pequim intensificou este ano a fiscalização do setor de veículos elétricos e introduziu requisitos de segurança mais rigorosos, à medida que as montadoras, envolvidas em uma acirrada guerra de preços, lançam novas tecnologias no maior mercado automotivo do mundo. A China também anunciou que proibirá maçanetas ocultas a partir de 2027, tornando-se o primeiro país a eliminar gradualmente um design popularizado pela Tesla e amplamente adotado pelos fabricantes chineses de veículos elétricos. A Tesla não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário, enquanto Geely e Xpeng se recusaram a comentar. A Xiaomi afirmou não ter informações adicionais além do aviso regulatório. A Leapmotor disse estar comprometida com a segurança. A empresa explicou que a atualização envolvia apenas um rótulo de advertência e a atualização do software de controle dos vidros elétricos, mas que estava “gerenciando e registrando o processo de acordo com o procedimento de recall por uma questão de responsabilidade para com nossos usuários”. A maioria das medidas, classificadas como recalls de produtos sob as regulamentações chinesas, visa as alças mecânicas de abertura de emergência das portas que, segundo os reguladores, podem ser difíceis de localizar ou acionar em caso de acidente — um defeito que tem sido alvo de escrutínio após vários casos de passageiros presos dentro de veículos em chamas. A mídia estatal chinesa noticiou em outubro que o motorista de um sedã Xiaomi SU7 morreu após um acidente e incêndio porque os transeuntes não conseguiram abrir as portas para retirá-lo do veículo.

item.title: Soja tem alta "expressiva" no Brasil e atinge maior nível em mais de 3 anos, diz Cepea
item.description: Os preços da soja no mercado brasileiro registram alta "expressiva" de mais de 5% na última semana, atingindo o maior nível nominal desde abril de 2023 no Paraná, em momento de entressafra e forte procura para processamento no país e exportação, avaliou nesta sexta-feira o centro de estudos Cepea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os preços da soja no mercado brasileiro registram alta "expressiva" de mais de 5% na última semana, atingindo o maior nível nominal desde abril de 2023 no Paraná, em momento de entressafra e forte procura para processamento no país e exportação, avaliou nesta sexta-feira o centro de estudos Cepea. Além disso, houve retração de vendedores, de olho em riscos climáticos do [USN:L1N44H12A TEXT:"El Niño"] para a próxima safra no Brasil e nas condições de desenvolvimento das lavouras nos Estados Unidos. "Esse cenário elevou a disputa pelo produto brasileiro", disse o Centro de Estudos Avançados em Economia Aplicada (Cepea). Os indicadores de preços Cepea/Esalq Paranaguá e Paraná subiram aos maiores patamares nominais diários desde abril de 2023, com o primeiro se aproximando de [USN:IGB7A6176 TEXT:"R$155"] a saca de 60 kg. De 13 a 20 de agosto, o indicador em Paranaguá avançou 5,2%, enquanto no Paraná subiu 4,5%. Na média das regiões acompanhadas pelo Cepea, os preços da soja subiram 3,8% no mercado de balcão (valor pago ao produtor) e 3% no mercado de lotes (negociações entre empresas). A demanda externa segue aquecida, sobretudo da China. No mercado doméstico, indústrias brasileiras vêm intensificando as aquisições para recompor e garantir os estoques, apontou o centro da Esalq/USP.

item.title: Reports: Marc Stad purchases lead stake in Wolves, Lynx
item.description: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday. Stad, the founder and managing partner of Dragoneer Investment Group, has been a minority investor in both basketball teams under the ownership group of Lore and Alex Rodriguez. The reported deal will need approval from the NBA Board of Governors, which has its next meeting on Sept. 15-16. Per reports, Stad's wife, Elisa, will serve as the Timberwolves' governor and Rodriguez will remain a co-owner of both teams. Lore, in turn, will move into a limited role in the ownership group. Per the Athletic, he is stepping away from his role as governor to focus on taking his food delivery and takeout business, the Wonder Group, public. The reported transaction comes approximately 14 months after Lore and Rodriguez assumed full control of the Timberwolves and Lynx from previous owner Glen Taylor. Lore and Rodriguez bought into the Wolves in 2021 at a $1.5 billion valuation, with an agreement to purchase the team in full from Taylor. Taylor bought the club in 1994 for $88 million. --Field Level Media

item.title: ANP avança para monitorar mistura de biodiesel por notas fiscais eletrônicas
item.description: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira consulta e audiência públicas sobre mudanças em regras para o biodiesel que permitirão à autarquia acessar diariamente notas fiscais eletrônicas de operações com o biocombustível e o diesel, ampliando e agilizando a fiscalização do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória pelas distribuidoras.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira consulta e audiência públicas sobre mudanças em regras para o biodiesel que permitirão à autarquia acessar diariamente notas fiscais eletrônicas de operações com o biocombustível e o diesel, ampliando e agilizando a fiscalização do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória pelas distribuidoras. Segundo a agência, o acesso aos arquivos eletrônicos das notas fiscais de biodiesel, diesel A e diesel B permitirá acompanhar continuamente as operações do mercado e identificar com maior rapidez eventuais descumprimentos da mistura obrigatória. Atualmente, o acompanhamento do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória de biodiesel é feito, principalmente, com base em informações declaradas mensalmente pelos agentes à ANP, por meio do Sistema de Informações de Movimentação de Produtos (i-SIMP), segundo a agência. "Como esses dados são enviados no mês seguinte ao das operações, o modelo não permite que a Agência adote de forma imediata os mecanismos de controle previstos na nova legislação", disse a agência. A consulta pública ficará aberta por 45 dias. O reforço da fiscalização ocorre em meio a preocupações do governo e do setor com fraudes na mistura obrigatória de biodiesel, prática que reduz a demanda pelo biocombustível e gera concorrência desleal entre distribuidoras.

item.title: Shakhtar to play Champions League home games at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge
item.description: Shakhtar Donetsk will play their home matches in the Champions League's league phase at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season, both clubs announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shakhtar Donetsk will play their home matches in the Champions League's league phase at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season, both clubs announced on Friday. The Ukrainian champions have been unable to use their Donbas Arena since Russian-backed forces entered the region in 2014 and were further displaced by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Since leaving Donetsk, Shakhtar have played domestic matches in Kyiv and Lviv, while hosting European fixtures in Hamburg, Warsaw, Gelsenkirchen, Krakow and Ljubljana. The move to London comes after Chelsea failed to qualify for European competition following a 10th-placed Premier League finish last season, leaving Stamford Bridge available for Shakhtar's Champions League campaign. "We are grateful to Chelsea Football Club for the opportunity to host our games at this special venue," Shakhtar said in a statement. "Stamford Bridge is one of the most famous stadiums in world football, with an incredible history and atmosphere. "We are convinced that Shakhtar's matches in London will provide unforgettable emotions for Ukrainian and English fans." Chelsea were formerly owned by Russian oligarch [USN:L8N3XN11K TEXT:"Roman Abramovich"], who was sanctioned by the UK government following Moscow's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, triggering the sale of the club to a group led by American investor Todd Boehly and Clearlake Capital. Stamford Bridge has a capacity of around 40,000. "Shakhtar have played in countries across Europe and we look forward to welcoming them to London for their Champions League campaign this year," Chelsea said. "We will be working closely with the Shakhtar team over the coming weeks to ensure that matchdays run safely and smoothly for their team and supporters."

item.title: Turkey to seek Interpol notice for Netanyahu in Gaza flotilla case
item.description: Turkey said on Friday it would seek an Interpol red notice for the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as part of a domestic criminal case linked to an attack on activists seeking to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turkey said on Friday it would seek an Interpol red notice for the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as part of a domestic criminal case linked to an attack on activists seeking to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza. NATO member Turkey has been one of the fiercest critics of Israel's assault on Gaza and has previously issued domestic arrest warrants for Netanyahu over the war there. It has repeatedly called for international measures against Israel over what Ankara calls its violations of human rights and international law. Israel denies those charges. [USN:L6N41W0YA TEXT:"In May,"] Israeli forces opened fire on at least two vessels from the Global Sumud Flotilla sailing towards Gaza as it was making a renewed attempt to deliver aid to the enclave after earlier missions were [USN:L1N41E0DW TEXT:"intercepted by Israel"] in international waters. In a post on X, Turkish Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said arrest warrants had been issued for Netanyahu and another suspect on charges that included genocide, crimes against humanity and torture as part of a case against 35 people over the Israeli interception in international waters. "In line with the arrest warrants issued against Benjamin Netanyahu ... our justice ministry has requested that the interior ministry issue (Interpol) red notices for them so that they may be sought internationally," Gurlek said. Turkey will use all available legal mechanisms to ensure Israel is held accountable for its crimes in Gaza, he added. A red notice is a request to police forces worldwide to locate and provisionally arrest a person pending extradition. Interpol reviews requests submitted by member states before deciding whether to issue red notices. ISRAEL BRANDS MOVE 'PATHETIC' Asked about Gurlek's statement, Netanyahu's office said: "(Turkish President Tayyip) Erdogan's pathetic attempt to intimidate the leaders and soldiers of Israel, the only true democracy in the Middle East, will go nowhere." Turkey and Israel also [USN:L1N44H05K TEXT:"traded barbs"] this week over Syria, where Israel carried out [USN:L6N44F0E4 TEXT:"airstrikes"] on an air base it said Turkish troops could be deployed to, drawing condemnation from Ankara and criticism from the United States. Syria has said there were no plans to deploy Turkish troops to the base. Turkey's influence in Syria as an ally of Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa has stirred Israeli alarm since Sharaa toppled veteran leader Bashar al-Assad in 2024. Ankara has said Israeli rhetoric against Turkey and its actions in Syria are fuelled by the approach of a parliamentary election in Israel in October.

item.title: ウクライナ支援「有志連合」、24日に会合 ウ独立記念日
item.description: [パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - ウクライナ支援国で構成する「有志連合」は、ウクライナの独立記念日に当たる２４日にキーウで会合を開催する。

フランス大統領府によると、ゼレンスキー大統領が出席し、マクロン仏大統領、バーナム英首相、メルツ独首相が共同議長を務める。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）のコスタ大統領も出席する。北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）によると、シェケリンスカ副事務総長がオンライン形式で参加する。

仏大統領府は声明で「ウクライナがロシアの侵攻から自国を守れるよう、ウクライナへの支援を強化するという決意を改めて表明するだろう」とした。

item.title: 英裁判所、ヘンリー王子らに計954万ポンド支払い命令 プライバシー訴訟敗訴で
item.description:
Michael Holden William James
［ロンドン ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Michael Holden　William James

［ロンドン　２１日　ロイター］ - 英高等法院は２１日、ヘンリー王子や歌手のエルトン・ジョンさんらに対し、大衆紙デーリー・メールなどの発行元に９５４万ポンド（約１３００万ドル）を支払うよう命じた。プライバシー侵害を巡り原告側が７月に敗訴していた訴訟について、原告側の進め方が不当だったと判断した。

英高等法院のニックリン判事は同日公表された判決で、英大衆紙デーリー・メールの発行元アソシエーテッド・ニュースペーパーズ・リミテッド側の弁護士費用として９５４万ポンドを８月２８日までに暫定的に支払うよう原告らに命じた。

さらにニックリン判事は、追加費用は「補償方式」で支払うべきだと判断。これはアソシエーテッド社が費用が合理的かつ相応であったことを証明する必要はないことを意味する。同判事は先月、ヘンリー王子やエルトン・ジョンさんら７人が起こした訴訟について、電話盗聴などデーリー・メール紙による広範な違法行為があったとする主張を退けていた。

アソシエーテッド社への支払総額はこの日は公表されなかった。当事者間で合意に至らない場合、同社の費用は別途の手続きで算定されることになる。

王子は６年前に王室公務から退き、米国に移住していたが、今月、妻のメーガン妃とともに英国に帰国する計画だと、複数のメディアが１９日に報じていた。

item.title: Gobernador de estado mexicano Sinaloa retoma puesto tras acusaciones narcotráfico
item.description: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, quien había solicitado licencia tras ser señalado por Estados Unidos de vínculos con el narcotráfico, anunció el viernes que retomó su cargo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, quien había solicitado licencia tras ser señalado por Estados Unidos de vínculos con el narcotráfico, anunció el viernes que retomó su cargo. Rocha, de 77 años y miembro del partido gobernante Morena, se [USN:L6N41F05Q TEXT:"apartó temporalmente"] de su cargo a principios de mayo para enfrentar acusaciones presentadas en abril por funcionarios estadounidenses sobre sus vínculos con el narcotráfico, lo que él ha negado rotundamente. A finales de abril, el Departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos[USN:L6N41C18T TEXT:" hizo pública"] una acusación formal contra Rocha y otros nueve funcionarios y exfuncionarios sinaloenses por narcotráfico y delitos relacionados con armas. Los fiscales estadounidenses alegaron que mantenían una alianza con una facción del Cártel de Sinaloa conocida como los "Chapitos", liderada por los hijos del cofundador del cártel, Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán.

item.title: Ataque russo a shopping center na Ucrânia deixa 6 mortos e cerca de 90 feridos
item.description: Pelo menos seis pessoas morreram e cerca de 90 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando drones russos atacaram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, segundo as autoridades locais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pelo menos seis pessoas morreram e cerca de 90 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando drones russos atacaram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, segundo as autoridades locais. Seis crianças estavam entre os feridos no ataque ocorrido durante o dia na cidade natal do presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy, informou o governador regional Oleksandr Hanzha pelo aplicativo de mensagens Telegram. “Vinte e uma pessoas estão em estado grave, incluindo uma criança”, disse. Ele postou uma foto de fumaça preta subindo de um grande prédio industrial. Zelenskiy classificou o ataque como “absolutamente cínico e desprezível”, afirmando que um segundo drone russo atingiu o shopping center meia hora após o primeiro, em uma tentativa deliberada de atingir os serviços de emergência. “Ataques como esses são nada menos do que atos terroristas”, disse Zelenskiy no Telegram, instando o mundo a responsabilizar a Rússia. A Rússia está intensificando sua guerra aérea contra a Ucrânia, à medida que os combates no campo de batalha se aproximam da marca de quatro anos e meio. Na quinta-feira, 17 pessoas morreram em um ataque com mísseis balísticos russos à capital ucraniana, Kiev. A Ucrânia também intensificou seus próprios ataques contra a Rússia, visando instalações petrolíferas e infraestrutura logística para tentar minar a capacidade de Moscou de conduzir a guerra.

item.title: Palästinenser: Israeli erschießt Jugendlichen im Westjordanland
item.description: Ein Israeli hat im besetzten Westjordanland nach Angaben örtlicher Behörden einen 17-jährigen Palästinenser erschossen. Zudem sei ein 70-jähriger Mann verletzt worden, hieß es am Freitag. Der Schütze habe eine Gruppe jüdischer Siedler bewacht, die das Gebiet eines palästinensischen Dorfes betreten hätten. Nach Angaben des israelischen Militärs bewarfen Dorfbewohner die Siedler mit Steinen und verletzten einige, woraufhin der Mann das Feuer eröffnet habe. Der Vorfall ereignete sich in dem Dorf Sa'ir nahe der Stadt Hebron. Das israelische Militär sprach von einer "nicht genehmigten Wanderung" der Siedler.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ein Israeli hat im besetzten Westjordanland nach Angaben örtlicher Behörden einen 17-jährigen Palästinenser erschossen. Zudem sei ein 70-jähriger Mann verletzt worden, hieß es am Freitag. Der Schütze habe eine Gruppe jüdischer Siedler bewacht, die das Gebiet eines palästinensischen Dorfes betreten hätten. Nach Angaben des israelischen Militärs bewarfen Dorfbewohner die Siedler mit Steinen und verletzten einige, woraufhin der Mann das Feuer eröffnet habe. Der Vorfall ereignete sich in dem Dorf Sa'ir nahe der Stadt Hebron. Das israelische Militär sprach von einer "nicht genehmigten Wanderung" der Siedler. Das Gebiet steht unter ziviler Kontrolle der Palästinenser-Regierung. Israelis ist der Zutritt grundsätzlich untersagt. Im Westjordanland, in dem etwa drei Millionen Palästinenser und rund 500.000 Siedler leben, hat die Gewalt von Siedlern zuletzt zugenommen. Die meisten Staaten betrachten die Siedlungen als völkerrechtswidrig, was Israel jedoch unter Berufung auf einen biblischen Anspruch auf das Land zurückweist.

item.title: Ataque ruso contra un centro comercial en Ucrania deja seis muertos y unos 90 heridos
item.description: Al menos seis personas murieron y unas 90 resultaron heridas el viernes cuando varios drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos seis personas murieron y unas 90 resultaron heridas el viernes cuando varios drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales. Entre los heridos en el ataque, que tuvo lugar durante el día en la ciudad natal del presidente Volodímir Zelenski, había seis niños, según informó el gobernador regional, Oleksandr Hanzha, a través de la aplicación de mensajería Telegram. "Veintiuna personas se encuentran en estado grave, entre ellas un niño", añadió. Publicó una foto en la que se veía humo negro saliendo a borbotones de un gran edificio industrial. Zelenski calificó el ataque de "absolutamente cínico y despreciable", y señaló que un segundo dron ruso impactó contra el centro comercial media hora después del primero, en un intento deliberado de atacar a los servicios de emergencia. "Ataques como estos no son más que actos terroristas", declaró Zelenski en Telegram, instando al mundo a exigir responsabilidades a Rusia. Rusia está intensificando su guerra aérea contra Ucrania a medida que los combates en el campo de batalla se acercan a los cuatro años y medio de conflicto. El jueves, 17 personas perdieron la vida en un ataque con misiles balísticos rusos contra la capital ucraniana, Kiev. Ucrania también ha intensificado sus propios ataques contra Rusia, dirigiéndose contra instalaciones petroleras e infraestructuras logísticas para intentar socavar la capacidad de Moscú para librar la guerra.

item.title: Petrobras enters negotiations for four offshore blocks in Ghana's Keta Basin
item.description: Brazil's state-run oil company, Petrobras , said on Friday it had submitted an expression of interest for exploration blocks in Ghana and begun negotiations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's state-run oil company, Petrobras (PETR3.SA) , said on Friday it had submitted an expression of interest for exploration blocks in Ghana and begun negotiations. The West African nation's Ministry of Energy and Green Transition had approved its application to negotiate exploration contracts for four offshore blocks in the Keta Basin, Petrobras said. Sylvia Anjos, Petrobras' head of exploration and production, told Reuters that the Ghana blocks are geologically similar to Brazil's Equatorial Margin, which is considered the country's most promising oil frontier. The oil major plans to make Africa its main exploratory region outside of Brazil, Petrobras Chief Executive Magda Chambriard [USN:L2N3S8117 TEXT:"told Reuters last year"]. Beyond Ghana, Petrobras has been looking in to several African countries for opportunities, including Sao Tome and Principe, Namibia, Ivory Coast and South Africa. The move is aligned with Petrobras' strategy of replenishing oil and gas reserves through exploration in new frontier areas in Brazil and abroad, the company said in a securities filing. It added that it is evaluating opportunities to diversify its exploration portfolio and support long-term growth.

item.title: Why is Trump talking about the Keystone XL oil pipeline?
item.description: A social media post by U.S. President Donald Trump declaring that the Keystone XL oil pipeline "may be awoken from the grave" attracted attention this week in the midst of U.S.-Canada trade talks. Below is a look at the history of that project running through parts of Canada and the U.S., as well as details on the new oil pipeline proposal that follows a slightly different route:
item.dc:creator: Amanda Stephenson
item.content:encoded: A social media post by U.S. President Donald Trump declaring that the Keystone XL oil pipeline "may be awoken from the grave" attracted attention this week in the midst of U.S.-Canada trade talks. Below is a look at the history of that project running through parts of Canada and the U.S., as well as details on the new oil pipeline proposal that follows a slightly different route: WHAT IS KEYSTONE XL? Keystone XL was a proposed crude pipeline, roughly 1,900 km (1,181 miles) long, which would have carried 830,000 barrels per day of oil from the oil sands of northern Alberta to the major U.S. storage hub at Cushing, Oklahoma, and then on to Gulf Coast refineries. The project, which was opposed by many environmental and Indigenous groups, was rejected by U.S. President Barack Obama's administration and revived by Trump during his first term. Though construction work had started, the pipeline was never completed after U.S. President Joe Biden revoked a key permit for the U.S. stretch of the project in 2021. WHICH COMPANIES ARE INVOLVED? The company behind Keystone XL, Canada's TC Energy, lost billions when the pipeline was canceled. It later spun off its crude pipelines business into a new entity, South Bow, so that it could focus on natural gas instead. But Trump has been vocal about wanting to see the Keystone expansion built. Canada, the world's fourth-largest oil exporter, sends more than 90% of its crude oil production to the U.S., and many U.S. refineries are dependent on Canadian heavy oil. While South Bow previously said it had "moved on" from the Keystone project, forecasts for increased Canadian oil production led the company earlier this year to propose a new pipeline project called Prairie Connector. The 550,000-barrel-per-day project, which South Bow is working on in partnership with U.S. company [USN:L6N40P0K6 TEXT:"Bridger Pipeline, "]would run from Alberta to Wyoming and would use some of the Keystone XL pipe that had been installed on the Canadian side of the border before that project was canceled. South Bow has said it will decide whether or not to go ahead with Prairie Connector in 2027. The company's CEO has said he needs proof that a U.S. presidential permit is [USN:L6N42519C TEXT:""durable""] before proceeding. South Bow declined to comment on Trump's recent posts. WHAT ROLE DOES THE PIPELINE HAVE IN TRADE TALKS? Reuters reported Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney raised a potential revival of the project during trade talks with Trump [USN:L6N3VP0WR TEXT:" last October"], presenting it as a possible area of cooperation between the two countries. Trade talks then stalled for months. Trump posted a meme about Keystone shortly after announcing late on Tuesday night he had given Canada a three-day [USN:L6N44F0Z0 TEXT:"reprieve "]on more tariffs. He posted the meme again ahead of a new midnight deadline to reach[USN:L1N44I0GP TEXT:" a deal. "]

item.title: Edison data did not show Dominion machines deleted and switched votes in 2020 US election
item.description: Posts reviving a discredited claim that Edison Research data showed millions of deleted and switched votes in the 2020 election that made Joe Biden U.S. president have made a comeback online.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Posts reviving a discredited claim that Edison Research data showed millions of deleted and switched votes in the 2020 election that made Joe Biden U.S. president have made a comeback online. An Edison spokesperson referred Reuters to comments provided to media outlets in 2020 by company president Larry Rosin saying the firm had not produced any such report and had found no evidence of voter fraud. “All of this information is still correct,” Joe Lenski, Edison Research at SSRS executive vice president, said in an email of Rosin’s statements at the time. Posts in August nonetheless said that Edison found Dominion voting machines had deleted millions of votes and switched as many as 435,000 votes from President Donald Trump to former Vice President Joe Biden, sharing a clip from a 2020 One America News segment that made similar claims. The OAN segment attributed the information to an “unaudited analysis” of Edison Research data, which appeared in an anonymous post on the pro-Trump website TheDonald.win , citing Edison data. It was later promoted by the Gateway Pundit and subsequently amplified by OAN, Trump and some of his supporters . However, the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency said in November 2020 that it had found "no evidence that any voting system deleted or lost votes, changed votes, or was in any way compromised." In a December 2020 statement , updated in May 2021, voting machine supplier Dominion denied allegations that its technology deleted or altered election results and said there is no evidence to suggest that there was a “systemic problem with vote-counting machines." Dominion, rebranded as Liberty Vote following a 2025 acquisition, and OAN did not respond to Reuters’ requests for comment. In 2021, Dominion [USN:FWN2PH16I TEXT:"sued OAN"], [USN:L6N3UA0IH TEXT:"Newsmax"], [USN:L6N3UA0IH TEXT:"Fox News"] and other entities that had promoted the accusations. In 2024, Dominion and OAN's parent company, Herring Networks, agreed to dismiss the lawsuit and related counterclaims. Among the allegations in the original audit was that Pennsylvania’s voting systems had lost or deleted nearly a million votes and switched a quarter million votes from one candidate to another. Pennsylvania's Department of State spokesperson Matt Heckel told Reuters in an email that the state's November 2020 election was "free, fair, and secure, with no widespread voter fraud," adding that Pennsylvania counties conduct two separate audits after every election before results are certified. A Reuters investigation this year found that Trump administration officials and investigators have re-examined voter-fraud cases that courts and bipartisan reviews have rejected and, based on discredited narratives about Dominion voting machines, continue to try to [USN:L6N41Y16I TEXT:"invalidate"] voting machines before the midterms. Verdict False. Edison did not produce any analysis or report linking Dominion voting machines to switched or deleted votes during the 2020 election. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team.  Read more  about our fact-checking work.

item.title: Buyout firm Vista explores $3 billion sale of private markets data provider Allvue, sources say
item.description: Vista Equity Partners is weighing a potential sale of Allvue Systems, in a deal that could value the provider of data and analytics for asset managers and credit investors at as much as $3 billion including debt, four people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Amy-Jo Crowley, David French, Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: Vista Equity Partners is weighing a potential sale of Allvue Systems, in a deal that could value the provider of data and analytics for asset managers and credit investors at as much as $3 billion including debt, four people familiar with the matter said. The move comes almost five years since Allvue's efforts to list via an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange were thwarted by the end of a bull run in financial technology stocks in the fall of 2021. While many companies have struggled with subdued investor interest and depressed valuations in the years since, 2026 has seen a recovery in deal-making efforts involving specialized financial technology and data providers which have businesses resilient to the growth of artificial intelligence. Against this more positive backdrop, Vista has engaged bankers at Evercore (EVR.N) and Barclays (BARC.L) to explore sale options for the Miami-headquartered Allvue, whose products help manage investments, track performance and streamline back-office operations. Discussions with potential buyers are at an early stage, said the sources who cautioned that no deal was guaranteed and spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential information. Vista and Barclays declined comment. Allvue and Evercore did not respond to comment requests. Vista formed Allvue Systems in 2019 by acquiring AltaReturn and merging it with its existing portfolio company, Black Mountain Systems. The company has since expanded through acquisitions, including private markets software firm PFA Solutions in 2024. Allvue now generates more than $200 million in annual recurring revenue, one of the people said. Allvue could fetch somewhere between $2 billion and $3 billion in the event of a sale, said the person and a further source, based on the firm’s annual growth rate of more than 15%, margins exceeding 30%, and valuations achieved by comparable companies in the sectors. By comparison, when Vista pulled Allvue's IPO in September 2021, it was seeking a valuation of around $1.7 billion. As well as broader sector tailwinds, Allvue should benefit from perceived scarcity value, given few of its peers are not already inside large financial institutions. For example, BlackRock (BLK.N) completed its £2.55 billion ($3.5 billion) acquisition of Preqin in March 2025.

item.title: Schweizer Notenbank: KI kann Inflation anschieben
item.description: Künstliche Intelligenz kann nach Einschätzung der Schweizerischen Nationalbank (SNB) kurz- bis mittelfristig Inflationsdruck erzeugen. "Es werden Investitionsströme teilweise umgelenkt, was für den Rest der Wirtschaft Anpassungsbedarf und Schwierigkeiten bedeuten kann", erklärte SNB-Direktoriumsmitglied Petra Tschudin in einem am Freitag veröffentlichten Interview der Zeitung "Finanz und Wirtschaft". Eine mögliche Knappheit etwa bei Computerchips könne zu anziehenden Preisen führen. "In der kurzen oder der mittleren Frist kann also auch Inflationsdruck nach oben entstehen."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Künstliche Intelligenz kann nach Einschätzung der Schweizerischen Nationalbank (SNB) kurz- bis mittelfristig Inflationsdruck erzeugen. "Es werden Investitionsströme teilweise umgelenkt, was für den Rest der Wirtschaft Anpassungsbedarf und Schwierigkeiten bedeuten kann", erklärte SNB-Direktoriumsmitglied Petra Tschudin in einem am Freitag veröffentlichten Interview der Zeitung "Finanz und Wirtschaft". Eine mögliche Knappheit etwa bei Computerchips könne zu anziehenden Preisen führen. "In der kurzen oder der mittleren Frist kann also auch Inflationsdruck nach oben entstehen." Längerfristig könne KI die Produktivität steigern. "Das sollte das Preisniveau senken", erklärte Tschudin weiter. Produktivitätsfortschritte an sich seien allerdings kein neues Phänomen. "Sie führen eine Wirtschaft nicht per se in eine strukturelle Deflation." Im Juli lag die Jahresteuerung in der Schweiz bei 0,4 Prozent und damit deutlich unter den Werten in anderen Währungsräumen. Gleichzeitig beließ die SNB den Leitzins im Juni bei [USN:L8N42Q0KV TEXT:"null Prozent"] auf dem niedrigsten Niveau aller größeren Währungsräume. Richtschnur für die Geldpolitik der SNB ist eine Inflation zwischen null und zwei Prozent. Die bedingte Inflationsprognose der SNB, die zeigen soll, wie sich die Inflation bei einem stabilen Leitzins über die kommenden drei Jahre entwickelt, deutet gegenwärtig keinen Handlungsbedarf an. Tschudin warnte indes davor, aus der Prognose zu viel herauszulesen. "Die bedingte Inflationsprognose ist nicht so zu verstehen, dass die Zinsen drei Jahre auf dem Niveau bleiben werden, auf dem sie derzeit sind."

item.title: Russell se hace con la pole para el sprint del Gran Premio de Países Bajos, por delante de Norris
item.description: George Russell colocó a Mercedes en la pole position para la carrera sprint del Gran Premio de Países Bajos del sábado, por delante del McLaren de Lando Norris, vigente campeón del mundial de Fórmula Uno.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: George Russell colocó a Mercedes en la pole position para la carrera sprint del Gran Premio de Países Bajos del sábado, por delante del McLaren de Lando Norris, vigente campeón del mundial de Fórmula Uno. Russell marcó una mejor vuelta de un minuto y 11,567 segundos, superando a su compatriota británico por 0,041 segundos. Charles Leclerc, de Ferrari, saldrá tercero en la carrera del sábado, seguido por el McLaren de Oscar Piastri y el líder del campeonato, Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes. El héroe local, Max Verstappen, fue el sexto más rápido con Red Bull, y Lewis Hamilton, de Ferrari, el séptimo. El ganador de la carrera sprint se lleva ocho puntos, y los ocho primeros clasificados suman puntos para el campeonato.

item.title: Lavouras de trigo do RS sentem excesso de chuvas, mas Emater mantém estimativa de safra
item.description: As chuvas que atingem a safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul prejudicaram parte das lavouras do Estado, o principal produtor do Brasil nos últimos anos, mas a estimativa oficial da safra gaúcha não foi alterada, afirmou a Emater nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As chuvas que atingem a safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul prejudicaram parte das lavouras do Estado, o principal produtor do Brasil nos últimos anos, mas a estimativa oficial da safra gaúcha não foi alterada, afirmou a Emater nesta sexta-feira. "As lavouras de trigo apresentam desenvolvimento regular no Rio Grande do Sul, parcialmente prejudicado pelo excesso de precipitações, pela persistência de nebulosidade e pela baixa disponibilidade de radiação solar", afirmou o boletim semanal do órgão de assistência técnica vinculado ao governo gaúcho. "Apesar das limitações meteorológicas, o potencial produtivo permanece, em geral, satisfatório", declarou. A produção do Rio Grande do Sul foi estimada inicialmente em 2,2 milhões de toneladas, queda de 36,4% na comparação com a temporada anterior, com produtores reduzindo a área plantada, em parte por temerem os efeitos das chuvas associadas ao [USN:L1N42U0VD TEXT:"fenômeno climático El Niño"] no Sul do país. Com uma produção menor também no Paraná, outro importante Estado produtor, as importações de trigo pelo Brasil devem atingir patamares próximos de [USN:L1N44A11V TEXT:"recorde"] de mais de 7 milhões de toneladas em 2026/27 (agosto/setembro), segundo dados da estatal Conab. A elevada umidade no Rio Grande do Sul tem aumentado a pressão de doenças fúngicas, especialmente oídio, manchas foliares e ferrugens, que podem reduzir a qualidade e a produtividade. Além disso, eventuais chuvas na colheita também são danosas. "Nas áreas em floração, a elevada umidade do solo vem restringindo o trânsito de máquinas e reduzindo as janelas para a aplicação de fungicidas", acrescentou. Conforme o boletim semanal, as condições climáticas reduziram a taxa de crescimento e retardaram o desenvolvimento de parte das lavouras. A maioria das lavouras está em desenvolvimento vegetativo, representando 82% da área. As parcelas implantadas precocemente avançam para a floração, com 14%, e para o enchimento de grãos, com 4%, segundo a Emater.

item.title: U.S. Open tickets remain steep ahead of year's final Grand Slam
item.description: Fans hoping to catch some of the opening matches at the 2026 U.S. Open continue to face steep prices on the reseller market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fans hoping to catch some of the opening matches at the 2026 U.S. Open continue to face steep prices on the reseller market. The get-in price for the first round at Flushing Meadows in New York, which gets underway on Aug. 30, sits at $197, according to TicketData.com. That spans all combined day and night sessions for the Round of 128, and is 33.1% higher than the final get-in price for first-round matches in 2025. How the withdrawal of men's No. 1-ranked player Jannik Sinner on Friday may impact that pricing remains to be seen, as the ticket prices for the entirety of the 2026 tournament are tracking closer to last year. The average get-in price for all 60 sessions as of mid-day Friday was $283, down 8.6% over the past week to sit just 0.7% above 2025. The get-in price for the women's and men's finals on Sept. 12 and Sept. 13 sits at an average of $534, up 19.0% from last year. However, the average price for the second round ($206) is down 27.0% from 2025, the third round ($266) is down 25.3% and the fourth round is ($266) is down 37.8%. While Sinner will not compete in this year's U.S. Open, No. 2-ranked Carlos Alcaraz announced he will return from the wrist injury that sidelined him from the French Open and Wimbledon. Serena Williams, who made her return to singles at Wimbledon, has yet to announce whether she will also play singles at the U.S. Open. However, there is speculation she will play with Alcaraz in the mixed doubles event that runs Aug. 24-26. --Field Level Media

item.title: ACE Robotics voit un "moment ChatGPT" pour les robots humanoïdes d'ici fin 2027
item.description: Les "cerveaux" des robots humanoïdes pourraient connaître d'ici à la fin de 2027 une percée comparable à celle qu'a représentée ChatGPT pour l'IA, a déclaré vendredi Wang Xiaogang, président de la start-up chinoise ACE Robotics.
item.dc:creator: Laurie Chen
item.content:encoded: Les "cerveaux" des robots humanoïdes pourraient connaître d'ici à la fin de 2027 une percée comparable à celle qu'a représentée ChatGPT pour l'IA, a déclaré vendredi Wang Xiaogang, président de la start-up chinoise ACE Robotics. "Nous pensons atteindre notre 'moment ChatGPT' grâce aux modèles du monde et à la collecte de données sur l'environnement", a-t-il déclaré à Reuters. "Même si nous atteignons ce point d'inflexion d'ici fin 2027, il faudrait encore quatre à cinq ans avant de voir ces technologies largement déployées dans différents secteurs", a ajouté Wang Xiaogang, également cofondateur de SenseTime, spécialiste chinois de la reconnaissance faciale par IA. Si les grands modèles de langage comme ChatGPT ou DeepSeek se sont imposés dans le monde entier, les modèles d'IA permettant aux robots d'évoluer de manière autonome dans des environnements inconnus restent encore loin d'être aboutis. Les investisseurs accordent désormais davantage d'importance aux applications concrètes qu'aux démonstrations de danse ou de performances sportives. Cette semaine, Wang Xingxing, fondateur du constructeur chinois Unitree, a estimé que les "cerveaux" des robots pourraient connaître une avancée majeure d'ici deux à trois ans au plus tôt. Comme d'autres dirigeants du secteur, il a souligné que l'accès à des données d'entraînement de qualité issues du monde réel demeurait l'un des principaux obstacles. Fondée en juillet 2025 et soutenue notamment par Ant Group et SenseTime, ACE Robotics a levé plus de 100 millions de dollars (86 millions d'euros) au cours du premier semestre de cette année. Selon Wang Xiaogang, l'entreprise ambitionne de s'introduire en Bourse "dès que cela sera possible", alors que la réglementation chinoise impose généralement au moins trois années d'activité avant une cotation. Le modèle open source Kairos-4B d'ACE Robotics figure en tête de plusieurs classements publics, devant notamment Cosmos 3 de Nvidia et Lingbot d'Ant Group. Ce modèle du monde intègre la perception, la compréhension multimodale, la simulation physique et la planification des actions. Il est également capable de générer des séquences vidéo et de prédire des actions sur plusieurs minutes. LA COLLECTE DE DONNÉES S'ACCÉLÈRE De nombreuses entreprises du secteur, dont [USN:L6N44G0KD TEXT:"Unitree"] et la start-up X Square, développent leurs propres modèles d’IA incarnée, mais Wang Xiaogang indique que "ces dernières années, l’ensemble du secteur n'a accumulé qu'environ 100.000 heures de données, ce qui est très insuffisant". Il affirme qu'ACE accélère la collecte de données en équipant de capteurs légers des opérateurs travaillant sur de véritables lignes de production. "L'efficacité de collecte est extrêmement élevée. Nous prévoyons d'accumuler des dizaines de millions d'heures de données dans les deux prochaines années", a-t-il ajouté. De nombreuses entreprises entraînent leurs robots par téléopération physique : des travailleurs équipés d'exosquelettes et de contrôleurs répètent les mêmes mouvements des centaines de fois afin de générer des données d'apprentissage. ACE déploie ses modèles dans des magasins automatisés, des hôtels et des entrepôts de livraison rapide, avec des robots humanoïdes fabriqués par Unitree, AgiBot et Fourier. "Nous prévoyons un déploiement dans au moins 1.000 magasins au cours de l'année à venir, puis dans 10.000 magasins d'ici deux ans", a déclaré Wang Xiaogang. Pour entraîner ses modèles, l'entreprise utilise des puces d'IA de Nvidia mais aussi de fabricants chinois comme Rhino Tech et Digua Robotics. "Cela nous permet de diversifier notre chaîne d'approvisionnement, car nous aurons besoin à l'avenir de solutions matérielles intelligentes complètes à des coûts bien plus faibles", a-t-il ajouté.

item.title: Guggenheim fund hits 17-year low after short-seller claims
item.description: Shares of close-ended Guggenheim Strategic Opportunities Fund hit their lowest level in over 17 years on Friday, a day after dropping sharply following allegations from a short-seller.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shares of close-ended Guggenheim Strategic Opportunities Fund hit their lowest level in over 17 years on Friday, a day after dropping sharply following allegations from a short-seller. Its shares (GOF.N) were last down 3.7% at $9.07, their lowest since March 2009, a day after plunging over 6% on record volume. Here are some details: In a Substack post on Thursday, The Bear Cave, a newsletter focused on short-selling owned by Hunterbrook Media, alleged the fund has been paying distributions to shareholders by selling new shares at a premium to its net asset value, and questioned how the payments could continue in the future. The fund — whose biggest holdings include mortgage-backed securities and other fixed income assets — was trading at an 8.7% discount to NAV at Thursday's close, according to Guggenheim's website. The NAV last stood at $10.32. Guggenheim Partners and Hunterbrook did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Hunterbrook Media's investment affiliate, Hunterbrook Capital, does not have any positions related to the fund, according to the newsletter. Earlier this week, media reports [USN:L4N44E0LU TEXT:"said"] that U.S. federal prosecutors and the SEC are probing Guggenheim Partners CEO Mark Walter's business empire to determine whether Walter or his businesses committed fraud by concealing financial connections while borrowing billions of dollars from insurers he controls. TWG Global, Walter's holding company, said on Tuesday it had agreed to [USN:L4N44F0SP TEXT:"swap"] up to $6.5 billion of Walter's insurance company Delaware Life's related-party investments for an equivalent amount of assets classified as independent.

item.title: Tennis-Blessé, le N°1 mondial Jannik Sinner forfait pour l'US Open
item.description: Le numéro un mondial Jannik Sinner a déclaré forfait pour l'US Open (23 août-13 septembre) à cause d'une douleur persistante au genou droit, a indiqué vendredi le joueur italien de 24 ans.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le numéro un mondial Jannik Sinner a déclaré forfait pour l'US Open (23 août-13 septembre) à cause d'une douleur persistante au genou droit, a indiqué vendredi le joueur italien de 24 ans. Vainqueur de son cinquième titre du Grand Chelem sur la pelouse de Wimbledon le mois dernier, Jannik Sinner s'est depuis blessé au genou et a dû se retirer du Master 1000 de Cincinnati et de l'Open du Canada, deux tournois importants dans la préparation de l'US Open. "Même si j'ai travaillé dur avec mon équipe et le staff médical, nous avons désormais pris la décision difficile que je ne pourrai pas participer à l'US Open cette année", a-t-il déclaré sur X. "Nous avons été de retour sur le court à Monte-Carlo ces deux derniers jours et avons réalisé que j'avais encore besoin de temps pour récupérer de mon problème à mon genou droit." Le forfait du numéro un mondial intervient alors que son plus grand rival, Carlos Alcaraz, a confirmé sa présence à Flushing Meadows, après quatre mois d'absence. Tenant du titre, l'Espagnol est désormais le grand favori à sa propre succession, malgré l'incertitude liée à son absence prolongée.

item.title: Orbital data center startup Starcloud valued at $2.3 billion in latest funding
item.description: Starcloud, a startup building data centers in space, said on Friday it had raised $250 million at a $2.3 billion valuation, as it looks to expand AI infrastructure through orbital data centers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Starcloud, a startup building data centers in space, said on Friday it had raised $250 million at a $2.3 billion valuation, as it looks to expand AI infrastructure through orbital data centers. SpaceX's (SPCX.O) [USN:L6N42J1AD TEXT:"blockbuster IPO"] has rekindled investor interest in the space industry, including in emerging areas such as orbital data centers. Here are some details: Manhattan West led the round that included new investors Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Cisco Investments (CSCO.O) , alongside existing backers Benchmark, EQT and Soma, among others. The startup was previously valued at [USN:L6N40E0WQ TEXT:"$1.1 billion in March"], when it raised $170 million. The funding brings Starcloud's total capital raised to $450 million since its founding in 2024. The startup said it was working with Nvidia on the Nvidia Space-1 Vera Rubin Module, designed to withstand radiation and extreme conditions in orbit. The capital raised will be used to fund manufacturing capacity expansion, engineering collaboration with Nvidia and procurement for newer products. Starcloud is targeting a constellation of 88,000 satellites and 20 gigawatts of orbital compute capacity, and building a 100,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Woodinville, Washington, for its next-generation Starcloud-3 spacecraft. Manhattan West's Lauren Selig has joined Starcloud's board as an observer.

item.title: Ken Griffin's Citadel sheds over $4 billion of Situational Awareness' bets
item.description: Billionaire investor Ken Griffin's Citadel has shed more than 80%, or $4 billion of bets, from the original portfolio of Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness that it recently purchased, according to a letter to investors seen by Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Anirban Sen, Arasu Basil
item.content:encoded: Billionaire investor Ken Griffin's Citadel has shed more than 80%, or $4 billion of bets, from the original portfolio of Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness that it recently purchased, according to a letter to investors seen by Reuters on Friday. Situational, an AI-focused hedge fund run by former OpenAI researcher Aschenbrenner, sold the [USN:L6N43W181 TEXT:"bulk of its stock bets to Citadel"] last month after heavy losses in its tech holdings forced it to unwind most of its public equities portfolio. Citadel has since completed nearly 100 block trades as it shed positions in the portfolio, which Griffin said included the largest intraday block trades of the year in 10 different names. The firm, which has about $77 billion of assets under management, declined to comment. "Our ability to distribute this risk was central to our investment thesis. These moments highlight our ability to quickly evaluate complex risks, deploy capital with speed and conviction, and execute with precision," Griffin said in the letter. Citadel is one of the world's most profitable and largest hedge funds, and has built a reputation for [USN:L6N43X1DP TEXT:"seizing opportunities during periods of market dislocation"]. After a selloff in AI stocks, the Situational Awareness portfolio lost 67% of its value in July, and was forced to unwind most of its $16 billion public equities book. Griffin and his top lieutenants had pulled an all-nighter to analyze the trading book positions of Situational and how liquid the bets were, Reuters reported last month. "A transaction of this magnitude could not have been completed without the extraordinary cooperation of the trading and prime brokerage teams at the banks serving both firms," Griffin said. Citadel Wellington, the firm's flagship multi-strategy fund, [USN:L1N4420KK TEXT:"gained 5.94% in July"], leaving it up 12% for the year.

item.title: Französische Behörden rufen Zehntausende unsichere Kondome zurück
item.description: Französische Behörden haben vor dem Gebrauch Zehntausender potenziell unsicherer Kondome gewarnt und rund 260.000 in Apotheken und Geschäften verkaufte Präservative zurückgerufen. Labortests hätten bei zwei Produkten ergeben, dass sie platzen oder Löcher aufweisen könnten, teilten die Anti-Betrugs-Behörde DGCCRF und die Gesundheitsbehörde DGS am Freitag mit. Verbrauchern, die diese Kondome verwendet haben, wurde geraten, sich auf sexuell übertragbare Krankheiten testen zu lassen und bei Ausbleiben der Menstruation einen Schwangerschaftstest zu machen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Französische Behörden haben vor dem Gebrauch Zehntausender potenziell unsicherer Kondome gewarnt und rund 260.000 in Apotheken und Geschäften verkaufte Präservative zurückgerufen. Labortests hätten bei zwei Produkten ergeben, dass sie platzen oder Löcher aufweisen könnten, teilten die Anti-Betrugs-Behörde DGCCRF und die Gesundheitsbehörde DGS am Freitag mit. Verbrauchern, die diese Kondome verwendet haben, wurde geraten, sich auf sexuell übertragbare Krankheiten testen zu lassen und bei Ausbleiben der Menstruation einen Schwangerschaftstest zu machen. Zudem seien auf Online-Marktplätzen 30 Kondomvarianten entdeckt worden, denen das EU-Konformitätssiegel oder eine französische Beschriftung fehle, hieß es weiter. Davon seien rund 1000 Schachteln mit mehr als 40.000 Kondomen verkauft worden. Die Plattformen hätten zugesagt, die Angebote zu entfernen. Auf der Warnliste stehen unter anderem zwei Produkte des japanischen Herstellers Okamoto Industries (5122.T) sowie die Marken My Lubie und Friday Bae von Passage du Desir. Die betroffenen Unternehmen äußerten sich auf Anfrage zunächst nicht dazu.

item.title: Malaysia's JDT stay unbeaten for world record 109th league match
item.description: Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT) set a world record of 109 consecutive league matches unbeaten after opening the Malaysian Super League season with a 3-0 victory over Kuching City in the Charity Shield on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT) set a world record of 109 consecutive league matches unbeaten after opening the Malaysian Super League season with a 3-0 victory over Kuching City in the Charity Shield on Friday. Marcos Guilherme scored in the 11th minute, while Oscar Arribas and Shahab Zahedi each found the net in the second half as JDT picked a comfortable win at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium. The win saw JDT surpass the 108-match streak that Ivory Coast's ASEC Mimosas compiled between 1989 and 1994, which the Malaysian club had matched with a 14-1 victory over Kelantan The Real Warriors in their final match of last season in May. The Southern Tigers have not lost a league match since April 2021 and have gone unbeaten through the last four Malaysian Super League campaigns. "It's a proud moment of my career being part of this amazing five-year run that has seen us go 109 matches unbeaten in the league, thus setting a new world record," JDT's Spanish coach Xisco Munoz said. "Our aim now is to keep this streak going and make the numbers even greater. Club CEO and former Liverpool Champions League winner Luis Garcia added: "I've played for and seen many dominant teams during my career in Europe, so I know how tough staying unbeaten can be no matter how strong you are. "Everyone just wants to beat you and treats every match against you like a final, same as how it is for JDT." JDT, chasing a 13th straight league title, have come close to completing a perfect season in recent years, dropping points in only one league game in each of the last three campaigns. The club drew 3-3 with Premier League side Chelsea in a pre-season friendly earlier this month. Having taken the first step in their latest title defence, JDT will look to extend their record streak when they face Kelantan Red Warrior FC on Wednesday.

item.title: Las potencias de Oriente Medio condenan los planes israelíes de asentamientos en Cisjordania
item.description: Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Turquía, Egipto, Indonesia, Jordania, Pakistán, Qatar, Arabia Saudita y los Emiratos Árabes Unidos condenaron las políticas de asentamientos de Israel en los territorios palestinos y dijeron que rechazaban categóricamente el proyecto inmobiliario residencial denominado «E1» en la Cisjordania ocupada.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Turquía, Egipto, Indonesia, Jordania, Pakistán, Qatar, Arabia Saudita y los Emiratos Árabes Unidos condenaron las políticas de asentamientos de Israel en los territorios palestinos y dijeron que rechazaban categóricamente el proyecto inmobiliario residencial denominado «E1» en la Cisjordania ocupada. "Los ministros exigen que se tomen medidas inmediatas para detener el plan de asentamientos 'E1', revocar todas las medidas adoptadas en relación con él y poner fin a todas las actividades de asentamiento y demás medidas destinadas a alterar el carácter geográfico y demográfico del territorio palestino ocupado", dijeron en un comunicado conjunto. Los diplomáticos añadieron que el plan constituía una "escalada peligrosa" que impulsaba aún más la expansión de los asentamientos y la anexión de territorios palestinos.

item.title: Russell takes sprint pole at Dutch Grand Prix ahead of Norris
item.description: George Russell beat McLaren's Lando Norris to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race on Friday in a strong statement of intent by the Mercedes driver as he seeks to turn around a tough first half of the Formula One season.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: George Russell beat McLaren's Lando Norris to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race on Friday in a strong statement of intent by the Mercedes driver as he seeks to turn around a tough first half of the Formula One season. Returning from the August break with an engagement ring and a fresh spring in his step, Russell produced a best lap of one minute 11.567 seconds to beat the reigning champion by 0.041 of a second and secure his third pole from five sprints so far this season. "It's great to be back here after the break. It's a circuit I love. It needs a lot of commitment," said Russell, third overall in the standings and 59 points behind teammate Kimi Antonelli. "It was a tough end to the first half of the year and I'm really happy to come back. "The lap felt really good. It all came together really nicely. It's always difficult these sprint qualifyings with just one shot on the soft tyre." LECLERC QUALIFIED THIRD FOR FERRARI Ferrari's Charles Leclerc will line up third on the grid for Saturday's race at the gusty seaside Zandvoort circuit with McLaren's Oscar Piastri fourth and Antonelli qualifying fifth in a damaged Mercedes after an early excursion into the gravel. Home hero and four-time world champion Max Verstappen was sixth fastest for Red Bull and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, Antonelli's closest rival in the standings and 50 points behind, qualified seventh with Alpine's Pierre Gasly eighth. The sprint winner takes eight points with the top eight scoring. The big points come from Sunday's main race, after Saturday's grand prix qualifying. "George is coming back. I think he feels so much pressure is off his shoulders after she (fiancee Carmen Montero Mundt) accepted his marriage proposal," joked Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff. Norris, winner of the last grand prix in Hungary before the break, said he could easily have been first or fifth considering the closeness of the field. "Maybe I could have just pushed it a little bit more, but otherwise the car has been performing well and looks like it’s continued its strong performance from Budapest," said the Briton. "It’s not an easy track to overtake (on) and the inside of the grid is a lot worse than the left side of the grid, so let’s see.” Antonelli went into the gravel during the first phase when he was only eighth fastest and Wolff revealed there had been significant floor damage that the team had patched up. "I had a couple of holes in the floor," said the Italian, who turns 20 next week. “When I came in, they initially said it was a loss of 25 points (of downforce). They tried to repair as much as possible, but definitely the damage was still there. I was struggling a lot in the low-speed corners." Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto qualified ninth with rookie Arvid Lindblad 10th for Racing Bulls. Liam Lawson, promoted from Racing Bulls to stand in for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull, qualified 11th while his Racing Bulls replacement Yuki Tsunoda was 12th. There was disappointment for Fernando Alonso at Aston Martin, whose hopes for a performance boost from the upgraded Honda engine were undermined by a rear wing problem on the Spaniard's car that left the double world champion at the back of the grid.

item.title: Zone euro-Légère amélioration surprise de la confiance des consommateurs en août
item.description: La confiance des consommateurs de la zone euro s'est légèrement améliorée depuis le début du mois d'août, montrent vendredi les résultats préliminaires de l'enquête mensuelle de la Commission européenne.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La confiance des consommateurs de la zone euro s'est légèrement améliorée depuis le début du mois d'août, montrent vendredi les résultats préliminaires de l'enquête mensuelle de la Commission européenne. L'indice est ressorti à -15,5 ce mois-ci, contre -15,9 en juillet, alors que les économistes interrogés par Reuters tablaient sur une dégradation à -16,3.

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street ouvre en hausse, la prudence reste de mise
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en hausse vendredi, rebondissant face à ses pertes de la veille, même si les turbulences sur le marché obligataire et les tensions géopolitiques freinent l'appétit pour le risque.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en hausse vendredi, rebondissant face à ses pertes de la veille, même si les turbulences sur le marché obligataire et les tensions géopolitiques freinent l'appétit pour le risque. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 274,50 points, soit 0,52%, à 53.033,71 points et le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large progresse 0,45% à 7.675,80 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) avance de 0,49% à 26.194,69 points. La flambée des rendements des bons du Trésor américain à long terme a suscité de l'inquiétude sur les marchés cette semaine, poussant le taux de l'obligation à 30 ans à atteindre, en début de semaine, son plus haut niveau depuis 2007. Bien que le Trésor soit intervenu pour annoncer qu'il doublerait les rachats de ces titres, les rendements restent proches de leurs plus hauts récents, ce qui, conjugué à l'impasse diplomatique au Moyen-Orient, incite les investisseurs à la prudence. Aux valeurs, les actions liées au [USN:L8N44I0DV TEXT:"secteur des crypto-actifs"] grimpent pour la deuxième séance consécutive, soutenues par la hausse du bitcoin après la décision du Trésor de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L8N44I0DV]

item.title: Gemeinde in Schweden: Mehrere Verletzte bei Schwertangriff
item.description: Bei einem Angriff mit einem Schwert sind in Schweden nach Angaben von Behörden mehrere Menschen verletzt worden. Zu der Tat sei es am Freitag an einer Oberschule in Fagersta in Zentralschweden gekommen, teilte die Gemeinde mit. Die Polizei nahm nach eigenen Angaben eine Person fest. Auf Anfrage der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters erklärte die Polizei, mittlerweile bestehe für die Bevölkerung keine Gefahr mehr. Nach dem Angriff wurden mehrere weitere Schulen und öffentliche Gebäude in Fagersta vorübergehend abgeriegelt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bei einem Angriff mit einem Schwert sind in Schweden nach Angaben von Behörden mehrere Menschen verletzt worden. Zu der Tat sei es am Freitag an einer Oberschule in Fagersta in Zentralschweden gekommen, teilte die Gemeinde mit. Die Polizei nahm nach eigenen Angaben eine Person fest. Auf Anfrage der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters erklärte die Polizei, mittlerweile bestehe für die Bevölkerung keine Gefahr mehr. Nach dem Angriff wurden mehrere weitere Schulen und öffentliche Gebäude in Fagersta vorübergehend abgeriegelt. Die Zeitung "Expressen" berichtete unter Berufung auf Insider, die Polizei habe auf den Verdächtigen geschossen. Reuters konnte diesen Bericht zunächst nicht bestätigen. Justizminister Gunnar Strömmer erklärte auf Anfrage, die Regierung stehe nach dem Angriff in engem Kontakt mit der Polizei. Der Vorfall ereignete sich ein Jahr nach einem Amoklauf an einer Schule in Örebro. Damals hatte ein Schütze zehn Menschen getötet und sich anschließend selbst das Leben genommen.

item.title: Iran-linked oil tanker falls victim to Somali piracy surge
item.description: An oil tanker under U.S. sanctions for allegedly transporting Iranian petroleum products has become the latest victim of resurgent Somali piracy when it was boarded off the coast of Yemen and diverted toward Somalia.
item.dc:creator: Aaron Ross
item.content:encoded: An oil tanker under U.S. sanctions for allegedly transporting Iranian petroleum products has become the latest victim of [USN:L1N41A07O TEXT:"resurgent Somali piracy"] when it was boarded off the coast of Yemen and diverted toward Somalia. The Eritrea-flagged Sibu 1 [USN:nL1N44H0CX TEXT:"was seized"] on Thursday by six armed individuals, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). The tanker was sanctioned last December by the U.S. Treasury for allegedly being part of a shadow fleet that helps Iranian petroleum products evade U.S. sanctions. The Sibu 1 was at least the 13th vessel attacked this year off the coast of Somalia or in the Gulf of Aden that links Somalia and Yemen, according to data from the International Maritime Bureau and reports by UKMTO. There were only five such attacks in all of 2025, according to the IMB data. Hundreds of attacks by Somali pirates from 2008 to 2014 created a security crisis in the western Indian Ocean that cost the global economy billions of dollars, including hundreds of millions of dollars in ransoms. A coordinated international security response largely ended those attacks and a spate of hijackings in 2023 and 2024 also died down following a robust naval response. But experts say the failure to address the root causes of piracy linked to poor economic and security conditions in Somalia mean it can always re-emerge. "The piracy was always suppressed. It was never really fully eradicated," said Timothy Walker, a senior researcher at the Institute for Security Studies in Pretoria. Experts have pointed to impacts of the Iran war on the piracy surge, including elevated oil prices that make tankers more attractive targets and the diversion of naval assets previously focused on piracy to the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea to deal with threats from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen. Some have cited evidence of collaboration between the Houthis and Somali pirates after several vessels were seized near the Yemeni coast. Jay Bahadur, a researcher and co-director of the Scopus Insights consultancy, said the seizure of an Iran-linked vessel like Sibu 1 made him very sceptical of Houthi links to the recent hijackings but added it was clear Somali pirates were receiving support from Yemeni nationals, including arms trafficking networks. "You're having these traditional, longstanding relationships built around arms trafficking and human smuggling built up between Yemeni criminal actors and Somali criminal actors," he said.

item.title: MARCHÉS-Le bitcoin s'envole après les annonces du Trésor US sur l'obligataire
item.description: Le bitcoin poursuit vendredi sa remontée, frôlant les 78.000 dollars, après la décision du Trésor de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le bitcoin poursuit vendredi sa remontée, frôlant les 78.000 dollars, après la décision du Trésor de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies La plus importante cryptomonnaie au monde, avance de 5,6% à 76.681 dollars vers 13h30 GMT après avoir frôlé les 80.000 dollars plus tôt dans la journée, son plus haut niveau depuis la mi-mai. Il y a seulement trois séances, le bitcoin s'échangeait à environ 64.000 dollars. Le Trésor américain a annoncé mercredi son intention de doubler les rachats de dette à long terme, afin de répondre aux craintes inflationnistes liées à la guerre au Moyen-Orient, mais aussi à l'envolée des coûts de financement dans un contexte d'augmentation des dépenses publiques. "Avec une dette publique américaine désormais supérieure à 40.000 milliards de dollars, toute politique visant à contenir les rendements obligataires ravive les craintes de dépréciation monétaire à long terme", écrit Antoine Fraysse-Soulier, responsable de l'analyse des marchés pour etoro. "L'or en profite, mais le Bitcoin également, avec son offre plafonnée à 21 millions d'unités, ajoute-t-il. En plus, le locataire de la Maison blanche a appelé cette semaine le Congrès à adopter une "version équitable du Clarity Act", un projet de loi qui, selon les entreprises du secteur des cryptomonnaies, leur apporterait une base juridique solide, mais qui est actuellement bloqué au Sénat alors qu'il ne reste que peu de temps avant la fin de la session parlementaire. Les actions liées au secteur grimpent en Bourse pour la deuxième séance consécutive.

item.title: Artificial intelligence could push up inflation - SNB's Tschudin says
item.description: Artificial intelligence can push inflation higher in the short term although the overall effect of the technology remains unclear, Swiss National Bank governing board member Petra Tschudin said in an interview published on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Artificial intelligence can push inflation higher in the short term although the overall effect of the technology remains unclear, Swiss National Bank governing board member Petra Tschudin said in an interview published on Friday. The central bank was looking closely at the impact of AI on prices, saying it could have an effect in both directions, Tschudin told newspaper Finanz und Wirtschaft. "Investment flows are being partly redirected, which can mean adjustments and difficulties for the rest of the economy," Tschudin said. "Shortages can occur, for example with chips, causing prices to rise. In the short or medium term, therefore, upward inflationary pressure can also arise." In the longer term artificial intelligence could also lower prices by increasing productivity and making goods cheaper, she said. But because inflation was calculated on an annual basis, to have a deflationary effect, this price decline would have to repeat itself regularly, she said. "Is that realistic? Productivity gains as such are not a new phenomenon. They do not, by themselves, lead an economy into structural deflation," Tschudin said. On Thursday, the International Monetary Fund's new chief economist Silvana Tenreyro [USN:L8N44H0UE TEXT:"also warned"] in research published by Bank of England staff that even if artificial intelligence boosts productivity, it may not lower inflation. In its latest forecast the SNB does not see inflation above or below its target range for annual price rises of 0% to 2% in the period up to the first quarter of 2029. Still, Tschudin said this should not be seen as a forecast the central bank will not change its policy interest rate, which currently stands at 0%. Instead the forecast was based on how the central bank saw inflation if interest rates remained unchanged. "If there is new relevant information about inflation, we adjust monetary policy," Tschudin said. "The conditional inflation forecast should not be understood to mean that interest rates will remain at their current level for three years. We do not publish interest rate forecasts."

item.title: Official creditors back Ethiopia bond restructuring, flag risks in warrant
item.description: Ethiopia's official creditors have approved a preliminary agreement between the government and private investors to restructure its $1 billion Eurobond, the finance ministry said on Friday, moving the country closer to emerging from default.
item.dc:creator: Nilutpal Timsina, Vincent Nzilani, Duncan Miriri
item.content:encoded: Ethiopia's official creditors have approved a preliminary agreement between the government and private investors to restructure its $1 billion Eurobond, the finance ministry said on Friday, moving the country closer to emerging from default. The East African nation struck an [USN:L8N43108T TEXT:"agreement in "]principle (AIP) with its bondholders in June to restructure the bond that was due in 2024 following several failed attempts, including a January proposal that bilateral creditors said did not comply with debt relief terms already agreed with Ethiopia. Ethiopia's Official Creditor Committee (OCC), which is co-chaired by France and China, has been studying the deal, the finance ministry said in a statement that also contained the letter from the group. "The OCC considers that, at this stage, the AIP is compliant with the principle of comparability of treatment and the Memorandum of Understanding agreed with Ethiopia," the committee said in its letter to the Ethiopian finance ministry. The move means the government will now go ahead with the implementation of the draft deal agreed with bondholders, the ministry said. Bilateral creditors and the government finalised a deal last year to restructure their portion of the external debt. OCC CAUTIOUS ABOUT NEW INSTRUMENT The committee, however, cautioned that the inclusion in the draft deal with bondholders of a "New Money Warrant" could ultimately result in bondholders receiving more favourable treatment than official creditors. This could force bilateral creditors to adjust their terms to match those of bondholders. The warrant gives bondholders the option to buy into a future Ethiopian bond of up to $1 billion at a market-linked interest rate, the terms of the June deal showed, and the government has an option to settle the warrant in cash instead, capped at $90 million. "Should the New Money Warrant be shown to grant excessive benefits to bondholders, such as through repurchase or redemption of the instrument, the OCC would consider the implications for the comparability of treatment," the OCC said. Market participants said the warrant was the key to unlocking the deadlock between the government and bondholders — a position that official creditors acknowledged. But the committee warned this would not set a precedent. "The OCC... will closely monitor its implementation before considering another potential replication of such an instrument in the future," it said. The Paris Club, which usually handles communications from official creditors for restructuring under the G20 Common Framework, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. COMMON FRAMEWORK TEST Ethiopia opted to rework its debt in 2021 under the G20's Common Framework — the sole remaining country still undergoing this process. The country defaulted on its sole Eurobond in 2023, following in the footsteps of Ghana and Zambia. Investors and campaigners pushing for fairer debt terms for developing nations see the resolution of its default as a test of the Common Framework, launched during the COVID-19 pandemic to streamline debt workouts. Its implementation has been marked by divisions between Western lenders, China and private investors that have slowed and complicated restructurings.
